curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a toast turns into a devastating public accusation, can the assembled family maintain their polite facade, or will the truth break through?
curatedMovie.description: At an opulent gathering for a wealthy patriarch's 60th birthday, the eldest son delivers an explosive dinner speech that shatters polite decorum and ignites a fierce clash between truth and denial.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A tense, emotionally heavy chamber drama balancing sharp suspense and steady, engaged reckoning.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Thomas Vinterberg, this Danish drama transforms an intimate family celebration into a gripping, emotionally heavy contest of loyalty and uncomfortable exposure.
